correctness.rationale: Headline is proved within its stated scope. Cover transfer over Q reduces twisted groups to S_k-invariants of H_*(F_k) tensor W_k. Character polynomials (chi_W from fix/g^2, chi_G=C(f,2)+m2, chi_H2=2f, chi_H4=f+2G+f(f-1)) re-executed exactly to n=12 and extended to all n>=4 by stable joint falling moments (E[(f)_a(m2)_b]=2^-b), giving <W,1>=0, <H2,W>=<G,W>=0 and <H4,W>=1 for every k. H0/H1/H2/H3 vanishing follows (W_2=0, coinvariants, F_k simply connected, G-invariants zero so im(D)=0). H4 dim 0 at k=2, 1 for k>=3: character gives the dimension and quotient-model orbit sums (verified S_k-invariant under the correct Q^k/(1) action, Gram rank 1 at k=3-11) exhibit the nonzero C-type generator. Finite claims re-verified: H5 quotiented 0 for 3<=k<=7 (k=4 rerun: invC5=4, rankR=36, dimcap=2, rankD=2), A6-piece 2 for 3<=k<=6, H4 1=1 at k=10,11. Limits (no H6 total, no uniform range, no geometric-map identification) are stated honestly.

originality.rationale: Single fused scope_literature_search over literal, equivalent-formulation, and dominance queries plus direct inspection finds only general twisted-stability theorems (Palmer open-manifold finite-degree stability), the Kriz/LS method (Idrissi/LS, Maguire Sage procedure for untwisted cohomology e.g. CP^3), and surveys (Kallel). None states, tabulates, or mechanically implies the exact integers for B_k(CP^2#CP^2) with Lambda^2(Q^k/Q): vanishing through H3, H4 0-vs-1 with C-type generator, quotiented H5=0 for 3..7 with D(R)=0, A6-piece 2, H4 boundary 1=1 at k=10,11. No database entry or stronger census covers this coefficient system on this manifold.

value.rationale: The low-degree exterior-square twisted classification of the named admitted object M=CP^2#CP^2 is an independently retrievable exact invariant: object and degree-2 system motivated before computation by the admitted stability target, values neither known nor mechanically implied by general ranges, explicit C-type generator plus reusable relation-quotient/D(R)=0 procedure, and concrete boundary data (H4 1=1 at k=10,11) ruling out sharp failure on H4 at i=4 and constraining any future full-range proof. Narrow exact datum of this kind is eligible without a new general theorem; scope is natural (i<=5 truncation plus stated boundary probe), not arbitrary.

material_sources.title: The Lambrechts–Stanley Model of Configuration Spaces
material_sources.relationship_to_claim: Provides the general LS CDGA model G_A(k) quasi-isomorphic to configuration-space cochains for simply connected closed manifolds; states no exact twisted integers for CP^2#CP^2 with Lambda^2 coefficients and no C-type generator or D(R)=0 quotient values.

material_sources.title: Configuration Spaces of Manifolds with Boundary
material_sources.relationship_to_claim: Extends LS-type CDGA models to unordered configuration spaces B_k(M) of manifolds with boundary in general; proves model-level statements only and computes no low-degree exterior-square twisted dimensions for the closed CP^2#CP^2 case.

material_sources.title: [PDF] a new approach to twisted homological stability, with applications to ...
material_sources.relationship_to_claim: Proves a general twisted-stability criterion for sequences of groups with coefficient systems (isomorphism for n >= c*k+2 under connectivity hypotheses); gives a qualitative range shape, not the submitted exact 0/1/2 dimensions or boundary 1=1 data for this manifold and system.

material_sources.relationship_to_claim: Proves twisted stability for configuration spaces C_n(M,X) with degree-d systems (isomorphism for * <= (n-d)/2); a general range theorem whose hypotheses cover many systems but whose conclusion never instantiates to the claimed vanishing pattern, H4 0-vs-1, or quotiented-H5/A6-piece integers.

perplexity_final_check.rationale: The terminal Perplexity check returned 20 results with 5 overlaps; the 15 incremental items are LS-model talks/slides, surveys, unrelated 4-manifold/trisection material, and two general twisted-stability theorems (Putman-style and Palmer-Anghel 1308.4397v2). The incremental general theorems usefully confirm the base-search picture but merely duplicate its qualitative-range coverage: none states, tabulates, or implies the exact CP^2#CP^2 Lambda^2 integers (vanishing through H3, H4 0-vs-1 with C-type generator, quotiented H5=0 for 3..7, A6-piece 2, H4 boundary 1=1).
